emails.subject: Backend Engineering Internship – Aditya Mittal
emails.body:
Hi EMotorad team,

Your backend intern posting calls for building production APIs and distributed systems in Node.js and Go, which is exactly the kind of bug I chased this summer.

At my Basepair internship I fixed a production OAuth race condition with DB-level row locking and patched multi-instance file-access failures with S3 on-demand fallbacks.

I'm a 2027 CS grad based in Noida and could work from your Gurgaon office. Is the backend internship still open?

tailor.reason: The JD lists AWS CloudFormation, distributed systems and caching as required skills whose exact wording isn't in the master resume even though the Basepair and Canopy work genuinely covers them.
